name: GPT-trainer
description: GPT Trainer is a platform designed to enhance and customize the training of AI models, particularly those based on the GPT architecture. It provides tools and resources for developers and researchers to fine-tune and optimize AI models for specific tasks and applications.

events.d: Find chatbots or a specific chatbot. Filter results by name and visibility.
Create a chatbot for your account.
Start a chat session for a specific chatbot (by UUID), optionally setting initial variables.
Send a message to a chatbot session; creates a new session if one isn’t provided.
Add a question-and-answer entry to a specified chatbot.
Retrieve a chatbot's data sources using optional filters for title, file name, or status.
Add a URL as a data source to a chatbot.
Add one or more source tags to a chatbot and optionally associate them with specific data sources.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a form is submitted.
Get a session by UUID or list a chatbot's sessions, optionally filtered by start and end dates.
Permanently delete a session and its associated data.
